Slop EML · free, in your browser

Open an .eml email file

An .eml file is one saved email. Drop it here to read it as it was sent: sender, date, subject, the HTML or text body, and the attachments.

Open an EML file

How to do it

  1. Drop the .eml file on the page, or choose Open. Several messages open in tabs.
  2. Read the headers and the body. Switch between HTML and Plain text when the message has both.
  3. Choose Show embedded images to see pictures that are inside the message.
  4. Select attachments and choose Download selected, or Download all.

Your files stay on this device: Slop EML runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Will the email load tracking pictures?

No. Remote images stay blocked and nothing loads from the network, so the sender cannot see that you opened it.

Can it open Outlook .msg files?

No. Slop EML reads .eml (MIME) files, the format most mail apps use when you save or drag out a message.

How are several attachments saved?

One attachment downloads as it is. Two or more go into one ZIP named after the message.

Is the email uploaded?

No. The file is read in this page and never leaves your device.
